prompts.name: noah
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 8-direction walking CHARACTER SPRITE SHEET for a 2.5D isometric neighborhood game. Create one original adult character Noah: adult man with warm tan skin, short wavy dark hair, teal-blue sweater over a cream collar, brown trousers, dark shoes; teactheir. Friendly proportions with slightly large head, rendered in warm clean illustrated game style with crisp edges matching a cozy isometric town. Camera consistently looks down at their from a fixed elevated isometric angle, approximately 30 degrees above horizontal. Genuinely transparent background, no floor, no scenery, no shadows, no labels, no grid lines, no watermark.
STRICT layout: exactly 4 columns by 8 rows, 32 separate full-body sprites. Every cell same size. Request1024x2048 pixels. Character same height in every cell, center x50%, feet baseline y85%, top of head y15%, keep all body parts within x20..80%. Each row is ONE facing direction and each column one animation pose.
Row1 facing toward viewer (screen south); row2 facing down-left (southwest); row3 facing left (west); row4 facing up-left (northwest); row5 facing away (north, back view); row6 facing up-right (northeast); row7 facing right (east); row8 facing down-right (southeast).
Columns in every row:1 standing idle feet togettheir;2 walking left foot forward right arm forward;3 passing pose feet near togettheir;4 walking right foot forward left arm forward. Do not rotate the camera. Rotate the character only. Each row's four sprites face exactly the SAME direction. All 32 sprites are the SAME PERSON wearing the SAME OUTFIT. Feet anchor must be consistent so a game can animate these frames without sliding. The left-facing rows must actually show left-facing silhouettes, the back row must show the back of the head and outfit. No additional poses or characters. The reference image is for visual style, consistent figure scale, eight-facing row order and four-pose column layout ONLY. Create the distinct new character described above; do not reuse Maya's face or apron. Preserve genuine alpha transparency.
